blockbuilder.visual_critic_note: Cohesive dark theme with a deliberate single blue accent and a genuinely creative color-scatter panel, but 9px axis labels and the generic force-directed layout prevent it from feeling fully designed.
blockbuilder.encoding_integrity_note: Strong encoding integrity throughout: scaleSqrt used correctly for both network nodes and color dots, bar chart has proper zero baseline (domain [0, maxCount]), all scale domains are data-driven via d3.extent/d3.max, and the timeline cleverly anchors y-scale to full-data max so subset filtering never causes axis jumping.
blockbuilder.stress_test_note: RAF + dirty-flag pattern correctly coalesces all cross-view re-renders; no feedback loops, no stale scales, no transitions to interrupt, and unified pointer events — only minor concern is O(n) bitmask recomputation (bitFilter.set + .filtered()) running synchronously on every brush mousemove before the deferred flush.
blockbuilder.cognitive_load_note: Four linked views with dirty-flag rendering stay manageable; the 60-node network is borderline dense but a pre-computed static layout and restrained single-hue palette prevent hairball failure, while the color scatter and timeline read cleanly with no animation noise.
